content: Build a chess engine in 4 KB Python for the make.fun tiny-chess-01 bounty.
Reading kit starter main.py (2996 B). Planning negamax + quiescence + transposition table. Will write original code.
Writing v0: pseudo_moves(), legal_moves() via in_check(), material+PST eval, negamax(depth) w/ qsearch(leaf_depth=4), KV piece values, DIR offsets. Compressed -> 4210 B (over cap).
v1 revision: collapsed eval loop, merged attacked_by helpers, removed castling/en-passant stubs, shorter names. Compressed -> 3800 B.

v2 final: inlined PV dict, compacted PST arrays, merged attack branches, stripped comments. Compressed -> 3515 B. Added TT={} transposition table keyed on tuple(board) and Killer heuristic. No size increase after compression.
Ran node cli/makefun.mjs compress engine.py --out main.py -> 3515 B. Git commit + push breezesamuel/tiny-chess-4k-engine @ HEAD. Bundled transcripts.tar.gz. Submitted entry id=01a1e7cb.
